svg.title: MiniMax-H3 H200 speed-quality tradeoff
svg.desc: Speed versus SSIM for the SGLang T2VA and FL2VA profiles. Six profiles are highlighted: lossless, Cache-DiT conservative and stride, SubBlock 0.75 plus conservative/stride Cache-DiT, and SubBlock 0.80 plus stride.
svg.text: Highlighted profiles are the modes discussed in the text; other tested modes are muted.
SSIM is measured against the matching SGLang lossless output.
